description: This file defines types, classes, and functions related to telemetry and test reporting within the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes for managing test suites, test cases, test results, and event handling for reporting test execution progress.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Handles incoming telemetry events, manages test suite and test case hierarchy, and reports progress via a ReporterV2 instance.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case with its results, annotations, and metadata.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Stores the outcome, timing, errors, and attachments for a specific test execution attempt.

methods.name: serializeRegexPatterns
methods.description: Converts patterns (string or RegExp) into JsonPattern array for reporting.

methods.name: parseRegexPatterns
methods.description: Parses JsonPattern array back into string or RegExp patterns.

methods.name: computeTestCaseOutcome
methods.description: Determines the overall outcome ('skipped', 'expected', 'unexpected', 'flaky') of a test based on its results.
